title: Microsoft Purview: preserve shared cloud attachment versions for users on hold
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the planned hold-based capability from the documented retention-label alternative, and its roadmap dates match the record. Minor corrections are needed to the wizard path, the Viva Engage preview qualification, and checklist references to controls missing from the table.

claims.claim: The Purview service description publishes licensing for retention labels and their policies under Data Lifecycle & Records Management.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle & Records Management; Licensing for retention labels; For retention label creation, the following licenses provide user rights:

claims.claim: A cloud attachment is a link to a SharePoint or OneDrive file rather than an embedded copy.
claims.quote: Cloud attachments are links to files stored in SharePoint or OneDrive rather than embedded copies.

claims.claim: A shared cloud attachment points to a live file that can change after sharing.
claims.quote: a cloud attachment points to a live file stored in Microsoft 365 services that you can modify after sharing

claims.claim: By default, eDiscovery collects the most current cloud attachment version.
claims.quote: By default, the eDiscovery workflow for collecting cloud attachments only includes adding the most current version of a cloud attachment to a review set or for export.

claims.claim: The version collected can differ from the version originally shared.
claims.quote: the version you collect and add to a review set or export might be different from the version that was originally shared in the cloud attachment.

claims.claim: Content present at sharing might no longer exist in the current version collected.
claims.quote: content that was present in the cloud attachment at the time it was shared might be removed and doesn't exist in the current version that's added to the review set or exported.

claims.claim: The existing retention-label option preserves the version shared as a cloud attachment.
claims.quote: Use retention labels to preserve the version of a document at the time when it was shared as a cloud attachment.

claims.claim: The existing option creates a copy at sharing and applies the selected label to that copy.
claims.quote: a copy of that file is created at the time of sharing. Your selected retention label is then applied to the copy

claims.claim: The existing label-based copy is stored in the Preservation Hold library.
claims.quote: Users aren't aware of the copy that is stored in the Preservation Hold library.

claims.claim: The cloud attachment retention label is not applied to the message.
claims.quote: The retention label isn't applied to the message itself, or to the original file.

claims.claim: The cloud attachment retention label is not applied to the original file.
claims.quote: The retention label isn't applied to the message itself, or to the original file.

claims.claim: The label should start retention using When items were labeled.
claims.quote: ensure that the label retention setting Start the retention period based on is When items were labeled.

claims.claim: The label alternative is reached through Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Label policies > Auto-apply a label > Apply label to cloud attachments and links shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage, and Copilot.
claims.quote: Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Label policies > Auto-apply a label; For Choose the type of content you want to apply this label to, select one of the available conditions.
claims.fix: Set the path to 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Label policies > Auto-apply a label > Choose the type of content you want to apply this label to > Apply label to cloud attachments and links shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage, and Copilot'. The auto-apply page supplies the omitted wizard heading; the already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/ai-m365-copilot supplies the final option label.

claims.claim: New-RetentionCompliancePolicy -Name "<policy name>" -SharePointLocation <site URL> -RetainCloudAttachment $true creates a cloud attachment auto-apply policy.
claims.quote: New-RetentionCompliancePolicy -Name "Marketing Department" -Enabled $true -SharePointLocation https://contoso.sharepoint.com -RetainCloudAttachment $true -Comment "Regulatory compliance for Marketing Dept."

claims.claim: After creating that policy, New-RetentionComplianceRule adds its retention label.
claims.quote: The next step is to use the New-RetentionComplianceRule cmdlet to add a retention label to the retention label policy.

claims.claim: RetainCloudAttachment is in Preview, not available in all organizations, and subject to change.
claims.quote: This parameter is currently in Preview, is not available in all organizations, and is subject to change.

claims.claim: The second row configures label-based cloud attachment retention rather than the new hold-based capability.
claims.quote: This example creates a new auto-apply label policy targeted to cloud attachments named Marketing Department with the specified details.

claims.claim: The existing label option does not support cloud attachments in encrypted emails or messages.
claims.quote: Cloud attachments and links in encrypted emails or encrypted messages aren't supported.

claims.claim: The existing cloud attachment label policy can be scoped to SharePoint sites.
claims.quote: SharePoint classic and communication sites for shared files stored in SharePoint communication sites, team sites that aren't connected by Microsoft 365 groups, and classic sites.

claims.claim: The existing cloud attachment label policy supports Microsoft 365 Groups locations.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Groups for shared files that are stored in team sites connected by Microsoft 365 groups.

claims.claim: The existing cloud attachment label policy supports OneDrive accounts.
claims.quote: OneDrive accounts for shared files stored in users' OneDrive.

claims.claim: Existing holds can be reached through Microsoft Purview portal > eDiscovery > Cases > case > Hold policies.
claims.quote: Select the eDiscovery solution card and then select Cases in the left navigation. Select a case, and then select the Hold policies tab.

claims.claim: Access links (cloud attachments) in messages is the option enabling linked attachment collection.
claims.quote: To enable the collection of cloud attachments, select the Access links (cloud attachments) in messages option so linked content is included in Add to review set and export workflows.

claims.claim: The existing label option includes cloud attachments shared in Viva Engage.
claims.quote: Support for cloud attachments that are shared in Viva Engage is in preview.
claims.fix: Add to controls[1].note: 'Support for cloud attachments shared in Viva Engage is in preview.' The cited https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/apply-retention-labels-automatically gives this qualification.

claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to inventory existing eDiscovery holds, but the controls table has no row for those holds.
claims.quote: Inventory which users are on eDiscovery holds today and note which are infinite holds; table rows: Whether cloud attachment versions are preserved for users on infinite hold; Existing alternative: retention label policy
claims.fix: Remove the 'Inventory which users are on eDiscovery holds today' checklist bullet: it reviews a control absent from the table. Do not add a new row.

claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to select Access links (cloud attachments) in messages, but the table has no collection-control row.
claims.quote: check which versions eDiscovery collects with the Access links (cloud attachments) in messages option selected; table rows cover only the new capability's gap and the existing retention-label alternative.
claims.fix: Remove 'with the Access links (cloud attachments) in messages option selected' from the pilot checklist bullet. The option is documented, but has no controls-table row.

claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to review the audit log, but the table has no audit row.
claims.quote: Review the audit log and Preservation Hold library storage for the sites involved; the controls table contains only the new capability's gap and the retention-label alternative.
claims.fix: Replace that checklist bullet with 'Confirm what reporting Microsoft documents for the capability before deciding how to monitor preserved versions and storage.'

claims.claim: eDiscovery treats a cloud attachment as part of its parent message.
claims.quote: Cloud attachments are treated as part of the parent's message, not separate entities.

claims.claim: A search matching the parent message retrieves its linked attachment even when the file does not meet the search condition.
claims.quote: If an email or Teams message matches the condition of a search, its linked cloud attachments are retrieved - even if the file doesn't meet the condition of the search.

claims.claim: Whether the new capability shares the existing label option's limits is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: cloud attachments infinite permissions preservation retention location prerequisites. Read edisc-cloud-attachments and apply-retention-labels-automatically; their limitations concern existing collection and labels, not the roadmap's new capability.

claims.claim: The interaction between the new hold-based capability and a retention-label policy on the same sites is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview preserve cloud attachments users infinite hold RetainCloudAttachment PowerShell. Read roadmap, edisc-hold-create, edisc-cloud-attachments and apply-retention-labels-automatically; none describes interaction of this new capability with existing labels.
